function.name: propose_context
function.description: Navigate retained context. With no changes, read a bounded catalog page (use next_offset to continue; catalog pins one inventory). With changes, propose include/park for offered occurrence CIDs, giving a reason and the catalog's expected_head. The receipt means queued, not accepted: the host validates at the next request boundary. Pins and live tool exchanges cannot be removed. summarise is explicitly refused; use re_read for verbatim sources.
